messages:
maria.s: FYI — Prospect 'Olympus' (payments platform) kicked off a security questionnaire and asked for a short POC. Key asks: SSO (SAML), SCIM bulk provisioning, RBAC (separation of admin vs user), domain ownership/locking, data residency, and a pricing comparison Hosted vs Dedicated. They also want a short timeline and docs we can share. Can we triage owners?
leo_sales: thanks — what do they expect for the POC scope? SSO + provisioning only or end-to-end infra as well?
devon_se: their message had two scenarios: 1) quick hosted API eval with SAML SSO + sample SCIM provisioning 2) a dedicated POC (reserved GPUs) for load/latency SLAs. For SCIM they want bulk import (50k users) and delta sync. Need to confirm rate limits. Also will need SAML metadata (entityID, ACS, cert).
devon_se: example SCIM mapping they requested (we should send):
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "external_username",
  "name": { "givenName": "firstName", "familyName": "lastName" },
  "emails": [{ "value": "email", "type": "work" }],
  "groups": ["roles"]
}
```
devon_se: note — for bulk delta they typically do a full import then incremental via PATCH. We enforce SCIM rate caps; we can propose a temporary bump for the POC.
alen_eng: on Dedicated sizing: if they test 50k users provision + 100 TPS gen traffic burst, they'd likely need a 4-GPU reserved pool for steady load with 1–2x burst capacity. Ballpark monthly commit for Dedicated starts ~ $XXk/mo depending on model family and quantization. For a Hosted POC we can do smaller sample traffic and use longer tail models; cost will be usage-based and easier to spin up.
alen_eng: technical notes — prefix KV caching + batching can keep latency under 200ms for typical 2k token sessions if we tune batch sizes. We should propose quantized variants for cost savings.
nora_sec: from security — please ask the prospect to return: completed questionnaire + SAML metadata (x509 cert), scope of SCIM operations (create/update/delete), data classification (PII/financial), and required retention/audit windows. Send them: pen-test summary, DPA template, SOC2 cert link. Also confirm if they require HSM/KMS for keys or if our managed KMS is acceptable.
leo_sales: can we get a 1-paragraph summary for pricing options (hosted vs dedicated + one-time POC support) that I can forward to buyer? Need numbers by EOD for their procurement.
devon_se: POC plan suggestion:
- Day 0: exchange SAML metadata, create test tenant + SCIM test tokens
- Day 1–2: run SCIM full import (we validate mappings), run sample SSO logins
- Day 3: perf smoke (10k users, ramp to 100 TPS), send latency/cost report
- Day 4: security & logs handoff, checklist close
We can compress to 48–72h if they accept a staged commit. Ask them for 3 test domains and a small sample CSV (100 users) to start.
maria.s: who can own the SAML metadata exchange and the SCIM mapping validation? Also assign the security docs to someone for upload to the prospect portal.
alen_eng: I can own infra + perf smoke. I'll need a liaison for domain ownership checks (to verify DNS TXT for domain lock) — ask prospect to create a TXT record we provide.
nora_sec: I'll drop the pen-test summary and DPA into the shared folder and prepare the security answer pack. Need legal contact for countersign.
leo_sales: I'll ask Olympus for procurement timeline and legal contact now. Expect reply tomorrow morning.
deploy_bot: ticket #POC-4921 created: POC Olympus — owners: alen_eng (infra), devon_se (integration), nora_sec (security). Links: https://redwood.internal/poc/POC-4921
maria.s: perfect — let's keep updates in this thread. Small ask: include estimated dedicated commit number (range) when you send pricing so procurement can budget. :thumbsup:
